data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian words 'ban' meaning 'wise' and 'zir' meaning 'intelligent'. The name Banazir carries the meaning “Wise and Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Banazir usually hope their child will grow to embody wise and intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Banazir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise and Intelligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Banazir total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
